verdict.rationale: This product is an Agent Skill that guides an agent to create logo SVGs and brand kits as local files. It has no production environment or production data, so a sandbox-versus-production testing axis is a category error for this kind of product. The 'test sheets' it generates (pixel, one-colour, squint tests) are design-quality checks, not isolated sandbox environments, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
